summary: Google's AI research notebook that grounds answers in user-supplied sources, with an Enterprise API and MCP server to manage notebooks and sources.
access_note: Requires an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license plus the Cloud NotebookLM User IAM role in a Google Cloud project; API is Pre-GA.
blocker_note: Enterprise license and Google Cloud project needed; MCP page says Workspace accounts not yet supported.

Some of the sources include Google Docs, Google Slides, raw text, web content, and YouTube videos.
The MCP server exposes 7 tools corresponding to the REST API methods.

notes: Fetched pages are summarized; auth quote on the bearer-token flow is partial. The MCP page lists OAuth scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/notebook and says Workspace accounts are not yet supported, which conflicts with the Enterprise license requirement of the REST API. Consumer NotebookLM has no API.
